resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: Verifiers correct — no formal free-tier quota; free use subject to polite rate limits (TOU + user manual). rate_limits: Confirmed at https://info.arxiv.org/help/api/tou.html — ≤1 request/3s and single connection for legacy APIs; user manual also urges 3s delay between sequential calls. example: Placeholders invalid; official sample is search_query=all:electron&start=0&max_results=1 returning Atom XML (user-manual Examples). description: Original is researcher meta-text, not a product blurb; replaced with accurate Atom/metadata summary from docs. status operational; base_url/docs/auth/free_tier confirmed.
free_tier_limits: No formal free-tier quota; free use subject to fair-use rate limits (≤1 request every 3 seconds, single connection). No paid plans.
rate_limits: ≤1 request every 3 seconds; single concurrent connection per source. Avoid bursts; use OAI-PMH/bulk for large harvests. max_results capped at 30000 (slices ≤2000).
